text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends reducing the duration of the permitted parking limit to a maximum of 1-hour on Meadow Avenue between 10:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side. There is "Permit Parking Only" on the south side of Meadow Avenue between Victoria Park Avenue and Blantyre Avenue. Currently, the by-law prohibits parking, except by permit from 12:01 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. on the south side of this street.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing maximum 12 hour parking regulation in effect at all times on the south side of Meadow Avenue, between Victoria Park Avenue and Blantyre Avenue. 2. Authorized parking for a maximum period of 1 hour from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of Meadow Avenue, between Victoria Park Avenue and Blantyre Avenue.
